verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Galileo captures sessions, traces, and spans, and can alert on a Cost metric. Nothing documents attaching custom metadata (user IDs, feature tags) to traces, or breaking down cost and usage by user, session, or feature. Session capture and cost alerts are adjacent capabilities, not the attribution this story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attribute cost and usage to users, sessions, and features via custom metadata
